#define DEBUG(lvl,fs,...)                                       \ /* <=== lib/hivex-internal.h:302:308:DEBUG:3 */ 
  do {                                                          \
    if (h->msglvl >= (lvl)) {                                   \
      fprintf (stderr, "%s: %s: " fs "\n",                      \
               "hivex", __func__, ## __VA_ARGS__);              \
    }                                                           \
  } while (0)

#define SET_ERRNO(errval,fs,...)                                        \ /* <=== lib/hivex-internal.h:310:314:SET_ERRNO:3 */ 
  do {                                                                  \
    DEBUG (1, "returning " #errval " because: " fs, ## __VA_ARGS__);    \
    errno = errval;                                                     \
  } while (0)
